desc:
The streets of Kamurocho are unforgiving. Become a legend.

Fight your way through the city’s criminal underworld, grow stronger, and rise from the bottom of the food chain.

🏙️ Explore Kamurocho, the city made famous by the Yakuza & Like a Dragon Series
👊 Fight enemies using powerful styles
💪 Level up and grow stronger
⚔️ Defeat stronger opponents and rise through the ranks

📱 Playable on PC, Mobile, Tablet, and Console

🤝 Find your crew in our Community! You can report bugs there too!
